have hBm : Measurable (Function.uncurry a.B) :=

findings.problem: The proof rebuilds joint measurability of the presentation's Brownian field `a.B` by hand. The same two-line derivation appears in at least a dozen other files. Examples are WindowTails, StochasticFubini, SpatialMeans, SmallKappaSausageMoments, InverseMoments, GreenCovariance, FiniteMass, ActualExplicitTransfer, PrescribedPublishedMain, PrescribedOrdinaryTransfer, CanonicalMassConstruction and GaugeGrowthDischarge. Each copy restates the type, either as `Function.uncurry a.B` or as the lambda `fun p : ℝ≥0 × a.samples => a.B p.1 p.2`. The `RegularSLEPresentation` namespace has no named fact for this. The proof therefore carries boilerplate that is not part of the multipoint argument.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma next to `measurePreserving_val` in `BrownianStrongMarkov.lean`:

lemma measurable_uncurry_B (a : RegularSLEPresentation P κ γ) : Measurable (Function.uncurry a.B) :=
  measurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_measurable a.continuous_B a.measurable_B

Then drop the `have hBm` here and pass `a.measurable_uncurry_B` in its place. The proof body becomes:

  simpa only [multipointConstant,Fintype.card_fin] using
    Multipoint.capped_physical_radius_multipoint_bound a.brownian a.measurable_B
      a.measurable_uncurry_B a.continuous_B a.zero_B hκ hκ8 γ a.G a.F a.witness hgrowth J hJ hJinj
      z hz hne (fun i => 2*(z i).im*‖deriv J (z i)‖) b e he hb hbR (fun _ => rfl) hsep

The other call sites can use the same lemma. `Function.uncurry a.B p` unfolds definitionally to `a.B p.1 p.2`, so the lambda-typed `hBm` statements are definitionally compatible.
findings.benefit: The proof reads as a single call to the theorem it applies. The reader no longer parses a measurability side-goal that is identical in every use of a regular presentation. One named lemma replaces the repeated derivation across the SLE files, and the form of `hBm` is standardised.
